profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Fullstack software engineer with a passion for functional programming and intuitive, concise front end design. Strong experience with cloud deployment architect relating to Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform. I've worked extensively with a myriad of cloud services such as AWS, GCP and most recently Azure DevOps, utilizing the tools offered for each service to build and maintain cloud based applications for backend and frontend projects. Most used programming languages include Scala/Rust for backend architect and JavaScript/React/Typescript for front end development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fullstack engineer for the Corporate frontend team and customer frontend team. Creating exciting products and services for both our employees and customer needs. 

Sanitizing complex data from different data sources so that we get the right data to the right services to the right people. Building elegant UIs for these data so that users have the best possible experience when interacting with our product and services. 

Building and innovating engineer work cycles within Acuity by implementing a developer portal where common knowledge between teams can be shared and stored. 

Using industry-standard cloud principles and architecture to build, deploy, maintain, and monitor our apps and services. Building our apps so that they are resilient to failures and compliant with all security mandates inside of Acuity.

Technologies used -
React/Typescript - GoLang - NodeJS - Dotnet - C# - Python - Kubernetes - Docker - Bit - Azure Devops

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Optimed Health Plans I worked extensively on all sides of development to help facilitate rapid business growth and build customer-facing services. Using React and Javascript I contributed to the foundation and architect for Optimed's Healthcare Portal for their members and brokers. Portal built with custom CSS and deployed and tested through a CI/CD pipeline. 

Developed backend applications and REST apis for all front-end applications using Scala and deployment with Kubernetes/AWS/GCP. Used Scala for ETL workloads and egressing data to external vendors.

Maintained and deployed all applications into cloud-based ecosystems (AWS/GCP). Utilized Docker and Kubernetes to orchestrate application management and Prometheus/Grafana for log tracking and debugging. Used Terraform to deploy and test dev and staging modules.

projects.title: https://effigydnd.com
projects.description:
Effigy: AI-Driven D&D 5e Engine
I built an AI Dungeon Master that runs full D&D 5e campaigns in-browser, utilizing multi-model LLM orchestration and deterministic game logic. The core philosophy of this project was to treat the LLM as a component of the system rather than the entire product—keeping mechanics, state, and validation strictly in code.

Live Project: effigydnd.com (You can request access for a beta key and I'll send one over)

Technical Architecture
Frontend: Next.js 16, TanStack Query, Vercel.

Backend: AWS Lambda (TypeScript) with response streaming, DynamoDB (Single-Table Design), Cognito, and SES.

Infrastructure: CloudFront distribution for global delivery.

Multi-Model Pipeline
Claude Sonnet 4.7: Primary narration and roleplay.

Claude Haiku 4.5: Intent classification (routing messages to either dice logic or narration).

GPT-4o-Mini: Context compaction and session log structuring.

Gemini Flash: Scheduled "world-ticks" to manage background NPC state.

Key Engineering Achievements
Deterministic Game Logic: Dice rolls resolve in TypeScript, not the LLM. The system handles d20 rolls, ability modifiers, proficiency, DC/AC checks, and advantage/disadvantage. This prevents the LLM from "fudging" mechanics.

State-Delta Management: DM responses include a hidden JSON state-delta block (tracking HP, inventory, and NPC moods). The server parses and applies these updates to DynamoDB before rendering the message to the user.

Context Optimization: Older chat data is compressed into structured session logs, maintaining a flat prompt size of ~12k tokens regardless of the campaign's length.

Extensible World Engine: Supports per-world race and class rosters for settings like High Fantasy, Cyberpunk, and The Witcher, with a custom engine for user-defined lore.

Solo Build. I am open to technical questions, feedback, or discussions regarding prompt engineering and LLM orchestration at scale.
